correctness.rationale: The rank-one decomposition of XY=YX=0 and exact rank-one character sum yield the stated integer Fourier multiplier. Its vanishing criterion reduces to exactly one rank-one interior point on a projective pencil. Counting secants, nongenerator tangents and (only for q=2) generator lines of the smooth hyperbolic quadric gives the nullity polynomial. Exact independent brute Fourier sums were checked for q=2,3 and selected q=4 frequencies; the count is exhaustively tested for q=2,3,4,5. The general proof is algebraic for all prime powers.
